note: NEW FAMILY (v0.6.0, hand-authored spec fixture — Rust-native, no Flask recording exists; DECISIONS.md 2026-08-24). A Bearer-authenticated request (CSRF checks bypassed) whose body does not parse as JSON takes the app-level 400 handler {"error": "Bad request"} — the same path export_pdf_post_400_missing_content.json documents for a non-JSON Content-Type. The import parser is STRICT (no get_json(silent=True) leniency — that closed set stays login, goal progress, achievements check): a missing, empty, or unparsable body is a 400, never a 200 no-op. A COOKIE-authenticated call with a non-JSON Content-Type never reaches this handler: the CSRF Content-Type check fires first -> 403 {"error": "Content-Type must be application/json"}. Message text not graded.
